Combined Alpha Model Country Rank. A 1-100 rank, relative to other firms in the same country, representing the StarMine Combined Alpha Model score for a security listing. Higher ranks are more bullish.

Combined Alpha Model Sector Rank. A 1-100 rank, relative to other firms in the same region and TRBC economic sector. There are ten TRBC economic sectors. Higher ranks are more bullish within a given sector.

Insight score derived from news articles relevant to Accident and Safety Management Category of any company. This topic addresses the corporate use of management systems and scenario planning to identify and understand exposure to possible catastrophic risks and prevent the occurrence of low probability, high impact accidents and emergencies. It relates to the culture of safety at a company, management systems and technological controls, potential human safety, environmental health, and social implication of these events occurring, and the long-term effects to an organization, its workers, and society should these events occur.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Biodiversity Impact of any company. This topic addresses impacts on ecosystems and biodiversity. This includes, but is not limited to, aspects of land use, ecosystem service benefits, biodiversity loss and habitat destruction, and deforestation. This topic relates to all stages of a company's interaction with ecosystems including planning, land acquisition, permitting, development, operations, and site remediation

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Business Ethics and Transparency of Payments category of any company. This topic relates to risks and opportunities surrounding ethical conduct of business, including fraud, corruption, bribery and facilitation payments, fiduciary responsibilities, and other illegal behavior that may have an ethical component. This includes sensitivity to business norms and standards as they shift over time, jurisdiction, and culture

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Competitive Behavior category of any company. This topic addresses the management of legal and social expectation around monopolistic practices, bargaining power, collusion, price fixing and manipulation, and patent and IP protection.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Customer Welfare category of any company. This topic addresses a company's ability to provide consumers manufactured products and services that are aligned with societal expectations of fairness, equity, and responsibility. It does not include issues directly related to quality and safety malfunctions of manufactured products and services, but instead addresses qualities inherent to the design and delivery of products and services where customer welfare may be a concern. This includes issues such as customer demand for products and services with health and well-being outcomes and ensuring supply chain integrity from counterfeit products.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to the Data Security and Customer Privacy category of any company. This topic addresses risks related to a company's management of sensitive, confidential, and/or proprietary data. This includes the safekeeping of customer data. It relates to technology practices, training, record keeping, cooperation with law enforcement, and other mechanisms used to ensure privacy and security.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Diversity and Inclusion category of any company. The topic addresses diversity and inclusion practices as it applies to hiring, employing, and promoting in the workplace. It covers the issues of discriminatory practices on the bases of race, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, and other factors

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Employee Health Safety and Well Being category of any company. This topic addresses a company's ability to maintain a safe and healthy workplace environment. This includes creating a workplace free of injuries, fatalities, and illness (both chronic and acute, and physical and mental health) through technology, training, corporate culture, regulatory compliance, monitoring and testing, and personal protective equipment

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Energy Management category of any company. This topic addresses indirect (Scope 2) greenhouse gas emissions through management of the use of energy in manufacturing and/or for the provision of products and services. It includes energy efficiency and intensity, energy mix, grid reliance, and other factors.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Fair Disclosure and Labeling category of any company. This topic addresses transparency, accuracy, and comprehensibility of marketing statements, advertising, and labeling of products and services. This includes, but is not limited to, advertising standards and regulations, ethical and responsible marketing practices, discriminatory practices against certain groups of customers, and misleading or deceptive labeling. It further addresses transparency of information and fair advice provided to customers and potential customers including, but not limited to, fees and penalties. The topic covers deceptive and aggressive selling practices where incentive compensation structure of employees may result in the sale of products and services that are not in the best interest of clients.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to the Fair Labor Practices category of any company. This topic addresses management's ability to uphold commonly accepted labor standards in the workplace, including compliance with labor laws, internationally accepted norms, and standards. At a minimum, this includes ensuring basic human rights such as those outlined in ILO Standards related to child labor, forced or bonded labor, exploitative labor, fair wages and overtime pay, and other basic workers' rights. It also includes competitive and fair salaries, minimum wage policies, and provision of benefits, all of which may relate to how a workforce is attracted, retained, and incentivized to act in the interests of the company. This topic addresses management's relationship with organized labor and freedom of association.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Fair Marketing and Advertising category of any company. This topic addresses transparency, accuracy, and comprehensibility of marketing statements, advertising, and labeling of products and services. This includes, but is not limited to, advertising standards and regulations, ethical and responsible marketing practices, discriminatory practices against certain groups of customers, and misleading or deceptive labeling. It further addresses transparency of information and fair advice provided to customers and potential customers including, but not limited to, fees and penalties. The topic covers deceptive and aggressive selling practices where the incentive compensation structure of employees may result in the sale of products and services that are not in the best interest of clients.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to GHG Emissions category of any company. This topic describes the management of direct (Scope 1) greenhouse gas emissions, including that from fuel consumption at stationary and non-stationary sources, exposure to regulation associated with carbon emissions, and relates to measures to mitigate emissions.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Human Rights and Community Relations category of any company. This topic addresses the management of the relationship between businesses and the communities in which they operate. It includes, but is not limited to, management of the core human rights in the community in which a company operates, indigenous peoples' rights, child labor, forced or bonded labor, and human trafficking. Additionally, the category covers socio-economic community impacts, community engagement, shared value, environmental justice, cultivation of local workforces, impact on local businesses, license to operate, and environmental/social impact assessments.
Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to the Lifecycle Impact of Products and Services category of any company.
Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to all material categories of any company.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Materials Sourcing category of any company. This topic relates to the integration of natural resource scarcity considerations into a company's approach to sourcing of materials as well as into product design and manufacturing. It relates to materials supply chain resilience to impacts of climate change and other environmental and social factors impacting availability and pricing of key resources. Approaches to management of the topic include the use of recycled and renewable raw materials, reducing the use of key materials (dematerialization), maximizing resource efficiency in manufacturing, and R&D investments in substitute materials. It also includes integration of resource scarcity considerations into product end-of-life management through take-back programs and material recovery. The scope of the topic excludes issues associated with screening, selection, and management of suppliers based on their environmental and social performance.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Product Packaging category of any company. The topic addresses integrations of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors in characteristics of primary products and services provided or sold by a company. It addresses reduction of environmental externalities created during product life cycle, including, impact of packaging, distribution, resource intensity of products in their use-phase, and end-of-life impacts of products. For service providers, it captures services which help customers reduce environmental and social impacts of their operations and/or their exposure to ESG risks. The topic covers company's ability to address customer and societal demand for more sustainable products and services as well as ability to meet evolving environmental and social regulatory rules.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Product Quality and Safety category of any company. This topic addresses a company's ability to offer manufactured products and services that are safe, reliable, and of high quality.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Regulatory Capture and Political Influence category of any company. This topic addresses a company's strategy and reliance upon regulatory policy or monetary incentives (such as subsidies and taxes), its actions to influence industry policy (such as through lobbying), overall reliance on a favorable regulatory environment for business competitiveness, and ability to comply with relevant regulations. It may relate to the alignment between management's and investors' view of regulatory engagement and management of regulatory compliance at large.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Supply Chain Management category of any company. This topic addresses the management of environmental, social, and governance risks within a company's supply chain. The supply chain is defined broadly and includes multiple tiers of suppliers from raw material suppliers to manufacturers of end products. It includes how companies screen, select, monitor, and engage with suppliers on environmental and social topics including environmental responsibility, human rights and labor practices, and ethics and corruption. The scope of the topic excludes issues related to impacts of climate change and other environmental and social factors on availability and pricing of key resources.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Waste and Hazardous Materials Management category of any company. This topic addresses the management of solid wastes, both hazardous and nonhazardous, in manufacturing, agriculture, and other industrial processes. It addresses treatment, handling, storage, disposal, and regulatory compliance. It does not address emissions to air or wastewater. It does not include waste from end-of-life of products.

Short-term, real-time performance pulse score derived from news articles relevant to Water and Waste Water Management category of any company. This topic addresses the management of water resources in manufacturing and/or for the provision of products and services. It addresses water availability, access, and scarcity; water efficiency, intensity, and recycling; competition for water resources; wastewater discharge, including groundwater and aquifer pollution; and regulatory aspects related to water management
